lines.zh: 盔甲响，骨头也在响。
lines.en: My armor clanks, and so do my bones.

lines.zh: 我沿着长廊走，脚下没有回声。
lines.en: I walk the long hall; my steps make no echo.

lines.zh: 这具身体走不快，但不会停。
lines.en: This body is slow, but it never stops.

lines.zh: 圣徽在胸口，早就锈了。
lines.en: The holy sign on my chest rusted long ago.

lines.zh: 我跨过同伴的骨头，没低头。
lines.en: I step over my comrades' bones without looking down.

lines.zh: 风穿过盔甲的缝，像笛子。
lines.en: Wind through my armor seams sounds like a flute.

lines.zh: 巡完这一圈，还有下一圈。
lines.en: Finish this round, and the next begins.

lines.zh: 剑尖刮过石板，冒着火星。
lines.en: My blade scrapes the flagstones and throws sparks.

lines.zh: 这座结构的每块砖我都认得。
lines.en: I know every brick of this structure.

lines.zh: 夜里我也走，眼睛不需要光。
lines.en: I walk at night; my eyes need no light.

lines.zh: 别挡路，这条线我走了一百年。
lines.en: Don't block me; I've walked this line a century.

lines.zh: 脚印留下又消失，我继续走。
lines.en: My prints appear and vanish; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一尊没人拜的像。
lines.en: I stand like a statue nobody prays to.

lines.zh: 誓言还在，神已经不在了。
lines.en: The oath remains; the god is gone.

lines.zh: 我记得自己怎么死的，很模糊。
lines.en: I remember how I died, but it's blurred.

lines.zh: 甲上的凹痕，每道都有名字。
lines.en: Every dent in this plate has a name.

lines.zh: 我试着祈祷，只咳出灰。
lines.en: I try to pray and cough up ash.

lines.zh: 这口棺材比我想的窄。
lines.en: This coffin is narrower than I expected.

lines.zh: 我的手指不会僵，也不会暖。
lines.en: My fingers never stiffen, never warm.

lines.zh: 有人把我的名字从碑上磨掉了。
lines.en: Someone ground my name off the stone.

lines.zh: 守着空殿，也算守住了。
lines.en: Guarding an empty hall still counts as guarding.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的心跳，是假的。
lines.en: I hear my own heartbeat, and it's false.

lines.zh: 活人的气味，我还没忘。
lines.en: The smell of the living — I haven't forgotten it.

lines.zh: 你是来取这殿里的东西？
lines.en: Have you come for what's in this hall?

lines.zh: 你的甲不合身，肩太宽。
lines.en: Your armor doesn't fit; the shoulders are too wide.

lines.zh: 我认得你腰上那把剑。
lines.en: I know that sword at your hip.

lines.zh: 别在我面前提神的名。
lines.en: Don't speak the god's name before me.

lines.zh: 你的手别碰那口箱子。
lines.en: Keep your hands off that chest.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还在动，真好。
lines.en: Your eyes still move. Good.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看百年前的自己。
lines.en: I look at you and see myself a century ago.

lines.zh: 你怕我，这很正常。
lines.en: You fear me; that's normal.

lines.zh: 站直了，让我看看你的骨头。
lines.en: Stand straight; let me see your bones.

lines.zh: 铁被砍开，里面的骨头裂了。
lines.en: The iron is cut, and the bone inside cracks.

lines.zh: 我不流血，只落铁锈。
lines.en: I don't bleed; I shed rust.

lines.zh: 这一剑，我记在账上。
lines.en: I'll put that blow on the ledger.

lines.zh: 你打中了旧伤。
lines.en: You struck an old wound.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲掉了半片。
lines.en: Half my pauldron came off.

lines.zh: 疼还在，说明誓言还没断。
lines.en: Pain remains, so the oath holds.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，可惜用错人。
lines.en: You have strength — wasted on me.

lines.zh: 我往后一步，剑没松。
lines.en: I step back, but my sword stays gripped.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，又接回去了。
lines.en: A bone cracked, then set itself.

lines.zh: 这点伤，一百年前就有了。
lines.en: I had this wound a hundred years ago.

lines.zh: 我不饿，饿的是甲里的东西。
lines.en: I'm not hungry; the thing in this armor is.

lines.zh: 你晃着那块肉，我闻不到。
lines.en: You wave that meat; I can't smell it.

lines.zh: 金子？我埋过比这多的。
lines.en: Gold? I buried more than that.

lines.zh: 我要的东西不在你手里。
lines.en: What I want isn't in your hands.

lines.zh: 那点光，照不亮我的盔甲。
lines.en: That little light won't reach my armor.

lines.zh: 你把剑递过来，我就动心。
lines.en: Hand me that sword and I'll be tempted.

lines.zh: 我从不吃，只喝雨水。
lines.en: I never eat; I only drink rainwater.

lines.zh: 你在引诱一具尸体。
lines.en: You're tempting a corpse.

lines.zh: 拿走吧，别在这儿晃。
lines.en: Take it away; don't wave it here.

lines.zh: 我的胃口在土里。
lines.en: My appetite is in the ground.

lines.zh: 你撞在铁上，会留下淤青。
lines.en: You hit iron; you'll bruise.

lines.zh: 我站着没动，你退了两步。
lines.en: I didn't move, and you fell back two steps.

lines.zh: 盔甲的棱角不长眼。
lines.en: The armor's edges don't watch where they go.

lines.zh: 让开，我这身东西很沉。
lines.en: Move; all this iron is heavy.

lines.zh: 你肩上落了点锈。
lines.en: A little rust fell on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开，因为你没让路。
lines.en: I shoved you because you didn't yield.

lines.zh: 撞我的骨头，会听见响。
lines.en: Bump my bones and you'll hear them rattle.

lines.zh: 我抬手要慢，怕伤到你。
lines.en: I raise my arm slowly so I don't hurt you.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我就过去了。
lines.en: Half a step aside, and I'll pass.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，寒气重。
lines.en: Don't walk so close; the chill is strong.

lines.zh: 我的婚约埋在城墙下。
lines.en: My betrothal lies buried under the wall.

lines.zh: 誓言说不娶，我就没娶。
lines.en: The oath said no wife, so I took none.

lines.zh: 这身甲里挤不下两个人。
lines.en: Two people wouldn't fit in this armor.

lines.zh: 她等过我，等到头发白了。
lines.en: She waited for me until her hair went white.

lines.zh: 亡灵不谈这些。
lines.en: The undead don't speak of such things.

lines.zh: 我连自己的脸都记不清了。
lines.en: I can't even recall my own face.

lines.zh: 谁会抱一具百年的尸骨？
lines.en: Who'd hold a century-old corpse?

lines.zh: 我把戒指留在祭台上了。
lines.en: I left the ring on the altar.

lines.zh: 别问了，我的答案都一样。
lines.en: Stop asking; my answer never changes.

lines.zh: 土里很安静，正好作伴。
lines.en: The soil is quiet — good company enough.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的头盔，扣上。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen helm and buckle it on.

lines.zh: 这块砖原本属于那面墙。
lines.en: This brick belonged to that wall once.

lines.zh: 手指太硬，捏碎了一枚徽章。
lines.en: My fingers are stiff; I crushed a badge.

lines.zh: 我把剑捡回来，它认得我的手。
lines.en: I retrieve my sword; it knows my hand.

lines.zh: 这串念珠少了几颗。
lines.en: A few beads are missing from this rosary.

lines.zh: 我拾起骨头，放回同伴身边。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and return it to my comrade.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我就收着。
lines.en: If something's on the floor, I keep it.

lines.zh: 重的东西才配得上这双手。
lines.en: Only heavy things suit these hands.

lines.zh: 我捡起硬币，看了看又放下。
lines.en: I pick up a coin, look, and set it down.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，拿回去。
lines.en: You dropped this; take it back.

lines.zh: 你踏进了我的守区。
lines.en: You've entered my watch.

lines.zh: 活的，会喘气的，都算敌人。
lines.en: Anything alive and breathing counts as a foe.

lines.zh: 圣光早照不到我，你也不该来。
lines.en: The holy light left me; you shouldn't have come.

lines.zh: 我数十下，你最好走远。
lines.en: I'll count to ten; best be far away.

lines.zh: 那把剑，我认得它的主人。
lines.en: That sword — I knew its owner.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在殿里太响。
lines.en: Your steps are too loud in this hall.

lines.zh: 命令还在我骨头里。
lines.en: The order still lives in my bones.

lines.zh: 你动了不该动的箱子。
lines.en: You touched a chest you shouldn't have.

lines.zh: 我盯上你不是因为恨。
lines.en: I'm fixed on you, but not from hate.

lines.zh: 这座结构只许出，不许进。
lines.en: This place allows leaving, not entering.

lines.zh: 你身上有誓约的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of an oath.

lines.zh: 站住，报上你的名。
lines.en: Halt and give me your name.

lines.zh: 我认得每个想偷东西的人。
lines.en: I know every would-be thief when I see one.

lines.zh: 天亮了也没用，我全天值守。
lines.en: Dawn won't help; I keep watch all day.

lines.zh: 你把火把带进这座殿，错了
lines.en: You brought a torch into this hall. Wrong.

lines.zh: 我的头盔转向你，铁在响
lines.en: My helm turns toward you, iron creaking.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地砖，我全记得
lines.en: I remember every tile you stepped on.

lines.zh: 我在你身后十步，一直。
lines.en: I'm ten steps behind you, always.

lines.zh: 你转过来，我就停。
lines.en: Turn around, and I'll stop.

lines.zh: 甲的响声会告诉你我在哪。
lines.en: The clatter of armor tells you where I am.

lines.zh: 你逃不出这座殿的门。
lines.en: You won't get past this hall's door.

lines.zh: 我拖着剑走，铁锈一路刮过石砖。
lines.en: I drag my blade; rust scrapes along the flagstones.

lines.zh: 你喘气越来越重了。
lines.en: Your breathing is getting heavier.

lines.zh: 我踩过的砖，会冷下来。
lines.en: The bricks I cross go cold behind me.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会慢一步。
lines.en: Don't look back; it costs you a step.

lines.zh: 你绕了三圈，还是这条路。
lines.en: You've circled three times; still this way.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，你跑不过我。
lines.en: I don't run; you can't outlast me.

lines.zh: 你的火把在抖，影子也抖。
lines.en: Your torch wavers, and so does your shadow.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己撞上来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to come to me.

lines.zh: 空气变冷了，那就是我。
lines.en: The air turns cold; that's me.

lines.zh: 你选错了一扇门。
lines.en: You picked the wrong door.

lines.zh: 我把剑尖放在你的影子里
lines.en: I set my sword's point inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 你走得快，我的甲响得更慢
lines.en: You walk fast; my armor rattles slower.

lines.zh: 这排柱子之间，只有一条路
lines.en: Between these pillars there is one path.

lines.zh: 你举盾的姿势，我见过很多次
lines.en: I have seen that shield stance many times.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只把门堵上
lines.en: I do not chase; I block the door.

lines.zh: 你每一步都踩在我的旧位上
lines.en: Every step you take was once mine.

lines.zh: 剑落下来，你的盾凹了。
lines.en: My blade falls and dents your shield.

lines.zh: 这一剑，是百年的力气。
lines.en: That swing carried a century of strength.

lines.zh: 骨头顶着铁，照样能断骨。
lines.en: Bone behind iron still breaks bone.

lines.zh: 你被震退，脚跟磨出了土。
lines.en: You're knocked back, heels scraping dirt.

lines.zh: 我的剑很钝，砸起来更疼。
lines.en: My blade is dull; blunt hurts more.

lines.zh: 别用劈的，我用压的。
lines.en: Don't try to slash; I crush.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝隙在左肋。
lines.en: The gap in your armor is at the left ribs.

lines.zh: 我倒下过一次，不会再倒。
lines.en: I fell once; I won't fall again.

lines.zh: 这一下，算替死者收的税。
lines.en: That one is a tax collected for the dead.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，就没退路了。
lines.en: Back to the wall — no road left.

lines.zh: 我的手腕转得慢，但准。
lines.en: My wrist turns slowly, but true.

lines.zh: 铁碰铁，火星落了一地。
lines.en: Iron meets iron, and sparks hit the floor.

lines.zh: 疼对你有效，对我无效。
lines.en: Pain works on you, not on me.

lines.zh: 我不用赢，只要你不走。
lines.en: I needn't win; only keep you here.

lines.zh: 我的剑砸在你盾上，手会麻
lines.en: My sword on your shield will numb your arm.

lines.zh: 这一下没劈开，但震到了骨
lines.en: That did not cut, but it shook your bones.

lines.zh: 我从棺材里坐起，灰落一身。
lines.en: I sit up in the coffin, ash falling off me.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一响，盔甲就开始响。
lines.en: The spawn egg clicks, and the armor starts rattling.

lines.zh: 这座殿又需要人守了。
lines.en: This hall needs a keeper again.

lines.zh: 我是被放进结构的，不是走进去的。
lines.en: I was placed in this structure, not walked in.

lines.zh: 一百年后，誓言自己醒了。
lines.en: A century later, the oath woke on its own.

lines.zh: 光从砖缝漏下来，我睁开眼。
lines.en: Light leaks through the bricks, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 没人给我办葬礼，我就自己起来。
lines.en: No one gave me a funeral, so I got up.

lines.zh: 剑还在手边，说明我还算骑士。
lines.en: My sword is still at hand; I'm still a knight.

lines.zh: 土松了，我推开上面的石板。
lines.en: The soil loosened; I pushed off the slab.

lines.zh: 空气里有活人的味道，正好。
lines.en: There's living scent in the air — perfect.

lines.zh: 我的名字被念出来，我就来了。
lines.en: My name was spoken, so I came.

lines.zh: 这具身体是旧的，命令是新的。
lines.en: This body is old; the order is new.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里走出来，铠甲还亮着。
lines.en: I walk out of the dark, armor still shining.

lines.zh: 谁把我叫醒，谁就得留下。
lines.en: Whoever wakes me has to stay.

lines.zh: 火烧不掉誓言，只烧掉布。
lines.en: Fire can't burn the oath, only the cloth.

lines.zh: 我从台阶翻下去，甲响了一路。
lines.en: I tumble down the steps, armor clanging.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲里，比死还沉。
lines.en: Water fills my armor, heavier than death.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，剑还在手里。
lines.en: The blast throws me down; I keep my sword.

lines.zh: 箭穿过甲缝，钉在肋骨上。
lines.en: An arrow slips my armor and pins a rib.

lines.zh: 圣光烧我，比刀更疼。
lines.en: Holy light burns me worse than any blade.

lines.zh: 吃饭是活人的事。
lines.en: Eating is a matter for the living.

lines.zh: 雷落在我剑上，骨架都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my blade; my frame lights up.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，誓言留在上面。
lines.en: I fall, and the oath stays above.
